name: OpenAI's Decisions API for calls that only pick a label
gain: OpenAI's words: typed answers "about 10x faster than the Responses API" (vendor claim). Nobody has measured it on this code yet.
how: POST /v1/decisions with model gpt-6-luna, the shared input and a choice, score or predicate question, plus a fallback option such as "other". Set the threshold from labeled examples, and keep today's call as the fallback below it.
replaces: A chat call asked to classify, route, answer yes or no, or score.
trade_offs: Only gpt-6-luna is supported, so this ties the call to OpenAI.
It returns a choice, a score or a probability and never generated text.
The answer is probabilistic, so a threshold has to be set and owned.
Files, audio and item references are not supported as input.
price: $0.10 per 1M uncached input tokens on gpt-6-luna; output tokens are not charged on /v1/decisions.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: high call count with few output tokens per call

gain_model.formula: calls * (current_cost_per_call - decision_cost_per_call), plus p50 latency difference

inputs.name: calls
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: current_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: decision_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: decision_input_price_per_m
inputs.source: OpenAI's price on gpt-6-luna, output not charged: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions

test_recipe.what_to_compare: agreement with the current call, p50 latency, fallback rate

verify_rule: Cost line and p50 for that call over 14 days; fallback rate under the gate

change_recipe.how: POST /v1/decisions with model gpt-6-luna, the shared input and a choice, score or predicate question, plus a fallback option such as "other". Set the threshold from labeled examples, and keep today's call as the fallback below it.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
